summary: Verified 2 bug fixes on Admin page: (1) SAP link backfill button and (2) pagination (50 rows/page). Both work correctly. Backfill is idempotent - second click correctly shows 'Nothing to backfill' toast, no errors. Pagination controls (Prev/Next/page indicator) work correctly with proper disabled states, DOM confirmed to render exactly 50 <tr data-testid=admin-row-*> elements per page (not 981), and page resets to 1 automatically on search text change, category filter change, and column sort change. Select-all checkbox correctly scoped to current page only: selecting all on page 1 (50 checked), navigating to page 2 shows select-all unchecked and individual rows unchecked, navigating back to page 1 shows original selections still checked (per-page toggle, global selection state persists).

No issues found in the reviewed backfill/pagination code paths.
